tickets.title: Add entitlement and IAP infrastructure for future monetization readiness
tickets.description:
## Opportunity
Zero monetization infrastructure exists. No concept of premium/tier/subscription in the entire codebase. Every monetization strategy requires a single authoritative is-this-user-allowed check.

## Current State
- UserProfile has no subscriptionStatus, userTier, or plan field
- FeatureFlagService (Firebase Remote Config) exists with rollout support but all flags are infrastructure flags, none are feature entitlements
- ImportRateLimiter has Firestore-persisted, window-based rate limiting -- mature but uniform per-user, not tier-aware
- No IAP packages in pubspec.yaml (no RevenueCat, no in_app_purchase)
- DataExportService is GDPR-complete (removes subscription compliance blocker)
- rate_limit_dialog.dart exists as natural insertion point for upgrade prompts

## Proposed Improvement
1. Add userTier to UserProfile + EntitlementService wrapping FeatureFlagService
2. Add RevenueCat integration for cross-platform IAP
3. Add tier-aware constants to ImportRateLimiter
4. Add recipe count enforcement via UserCounters
5. Add UpgradePromptSheet reusable paywall widget
6. Add conversion analytics events

## Effort vs Impact
Large (2-3 weeks for IAP). Blocking for any future monetization.

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Add collection stats dashboard with cooking milestones and value demonstration
tickets.description:
## Opportunity
The app accumulates valuable data but never shows users what they have built. RecipeQueryViewModel.recipeInsights computes 12+ metrics but NO UI consumes it.

## Current State
- recipeInsights getter (recipe_query_viewmodel.dart:395) computes: totalRecipes, favoriteCount, recentlyCookedCount, highRatedCount, mealType/tag distribution
- getMostUsedMealTypes(), getMostUsedTags(), getCookingFrequencyByMealType() -- all implemented, zero UI
- ProfileMenu shows only 3 numbers: recipes, menus, friends
- No cookCount field -- markAsCooked() overwrites single lastCookedAt (recipe_operations.dart:277)
- No milestone celebrations -- ActivityType.achievementUnlocked exists but zero logic

## Proposed Improvement
1. Add cookCount: int to RecipeCore (increment, not overwrite)
2. Create StatsView consuming recipeInsights
3. Add milestone celebrations at thresholds (first recipe, 10th cook, 50 recipes)
4. Add first-recipe celebration overlay

## Effort vs Impact
Small-medium. Very high engagement impact -- data already exists.

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Add cross-device cooking session sync with offline pre-save and QR handoff
tickets.description:
## Opportunity
Recipe apps are uniquely multi-device: browse on laptop, cook from phone/tablet. CookingModeViewModel (43 lines) is pure in-memory -- portion scaling lost on app close. No offline pre-save before cooking.

## Current State
- CookingModeViewModel holds _currentPortions in memory only -- zero persistence
- No recentlyViewed array anywhere
- OfflineService.saveRecipeOffline() exists but NEVER called before cooking mode
- No QR code library -- no way to scan recipe from laptop to phone

## Proposed Improvement
1. Write cooking_sessions/{userId}/current Firestore doc on cooking mode open
2. Call OfflineService.saveRecipeOffline(recipe) in CookingModeView.initState
3. Add recentlyViewed array (capped to 10) on RecipeDetailView open
4. Add qr_flutter + Show QR code action in recipe detail
5. Persist portion scaling to SharedPreferences per-recipe

## Effort vs Impact
Medium. High impact for multi-device cooking.

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Fix cooking mode accessibility: hardcoded fonts, small touch targets, zero Semantics, no checkoff
tickets.description:
## Finding
CookingModeView has multiple accessibility issues:

### 1. Hardcoded font sizes ignore system text scale
cooking_mode_view.dart:247 (fontSize:16) and line 342 (fontSize:18) override styles directly.

### 2. Portion buttons below touch target minimum
Line 277: buttons are 36x36px -- below 48px Material Design minimum.

### 3. Zero Semantics wrappers
Neither ingredient list items, portion counter, step numbers, nor close button have semantic labels.

### 4. No ingredient checkoff interaction
No way to tap ingredients to cross them off while cooking.

### 5. Orientation forced on all devices
Line 29-32: forces landscape regardless of device. No kIsWeb guard.

## Suggested Fix
Increase buttons to 48x48. Add Semantics. Respect text scale. Guard orientation. Add ingredient tap-to-checkoff.

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Fix web platform gaps: deep links broken, no keyboard shortcuts, no print, no clipboard auto-detect
tickets.description:
## Finding
### 1. Web deep links never processed (P1)
deep_link_handler.dart line 46-49 returns early for kIsWeb. Uri.base never parsed at startup. Shared recipe links only work on Android.

### 2. No keyboard shortcuts
Zero LogicalKeyboardKey/Shortcuts usage. No Cmd+F for search, no Space for cooking steps, no Escape for modals.

### 3. No print recipe
No print CSS, no print layout, no Print button for web users.

### 4. No clipboard monitoring on app resume
No WidgetsBindingObserver that reads clipboard for recipe URLs on resume.

## Suggested Fix
Parse Uri.base on web startup. Add Shortcuts widget. Add print button behind kIsWeb guard. Add clipboard monitoring.

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Add tablet-optimized layouts: two-column recipe detail, responsive cooking mode, adaptive image heights
tickets.description:
## Opportunity
Responsive infrastructure is thorough (6 breakpoints, ResponsiveBuilder, AdaptiveNavigationScaffold) but key views do not use it.

## Current State
- RecipeDetailView is single-column even on 1200px browser. ResponsiveUtils.useMasterDetail() exists but never called.
- SliverAppBar hero image hardcoded at expandedHeight: 200.0 -- narrow on tablet
- SmartImportView uses maxWidth: 600 but no adaptive desktop variant
- Cooking mode fonts do not scale with ResponsiveUtils.getFontSizeMultiplier()

## Proposed Improvement
1. Two-column RecipeDetailView on tablet/desktop
2. Responsive expandedHeight based on screen height
3. Desktop SmartImportView with side-by-side form + preview
4. Cooking mode fonts scale with getFontSizeMultiplier()

## Effort vs Impact
Medium. High impact for web/tablet reading experience.

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Add recipe lifecycle: archival, cookCount tracking, never-cooked filter, per-cook notes, broken URL check
tickets.description:
## Opportunity
Recipe collections grow but never shrink or reorganize. Users accumulate hundreds but only cook from ~20.

## Current State
- No isArchived/archivedAt field -- recipes exist or are hard-deleted
- lastCookedAt exists but no cookCount -- cannot answer how often do I cook this
- No lastViewedAt -- never-opened imports invisible
- No per-cook notes
- sourceUrl stored but never validated for liveness
- ContentFingerprint only does exact matching -- no retrospective fuzzy dedup
- SortCriteria has title/time but no lastCooked

## Proposed Improvement
1. Add cookCount field, increment on markAsCooked
2. Add SortCriteria.lastCooked and never-cooked filter
3. Add isArchived flag for soft-hide
4. Add per-cook notes (cookingNotes subcollection)
5. Add broken URL checker
6. Add retrospective duplicate scan

## Effort vs Impact
Medium. High -- transforms collection from static to living.

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Add seasonal proactive surfacing and contextual time-of-day recipe suggestions
tickets.description:
## Opportunity
Season tags (var/sommar/host/vinter) and holiday tags (jul, lucia, pask, midsommar) are computed on every recipe but never proactively surfaced. DateTime.now() is used nowhere in the display layer.

## Current State
- TagPhase4Mood generates season tags from ingredient seasonality + name-inference fallback
- Swedish holidays detected: jul, lucia, pask, midsommar, kraftskiva, nyar
- Manual filter by season works but user must know to look
- No time-of-day awareness
- No NotificationStrategy for seasonal/forgotten recipes

## Proposed Improvement
1. Add In Season Now section on home screen using DateTime.now() Swedish season mapping
2. Add contextual greeting: God morgon/eftermiddag/kvall with meal-appropriate suggestion
3. Add Forgotten favorites shelf: rating >= 4, lastCookedAt > 90 days
4. Add seasonal push notification

## Effort vs Impact
Small-medium. High discovery and engagement impact -- data already exists.

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Add household accounts: shared recipe collection, allergen aggregation, cooking assignment
tickets.description:
## Opportunity
Most recipe apps are single-player. Families cook together. Butlery has strong multi-user infrastructure aimed at friends but no household concept.

## Current State
- Recipes strictly single-owner. CollaborativeRecipeRepository provides real-time sessions but not permanent co-ownership.
- DefaultFriendCategories auto-creates Familj category but it is just a label
- RealtimeMenu has full participants model but no per-day cook assignee
- UserAllergenPreferences per-user. MenuGenerator filters single user. No union.
- No GroupType.household flag. No pantry/inventory model.
- Portion scaling single integer (1-20), no composite 2 adults + 2 kids

## Proposed Improvement
1. Add Household model with memberIds + auto-shared recipe collection
2. Add HouseholdAllergenService.union() for MenuGenerator
3. Add MenuDayAssignment with assigneeId per day/meal
4. Add shared pantry model
5. Add composite portion scaling

## Effort vs Impact
Large. Very high differentiation.

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Fix collaborative shopping list: no real-time Firestore stream, add shared pantry concept
tickets.description:
## Finding
UnifiedShoppingList has excellent collaborative infrastructure (ListType.collaborative, memberPermissions, item-level attribution). But the ViewModel does not stream changes.

### Real-time sync missing
CollaborativeShoppingViewModel._loadList() (line 93-120) fetches list ONCE on init from in-memory cache. refresh() is manual pull. No Firestore snapshots() stream. Partner adds milk -- change will not appear until manual refresh.

### No pantry integration
Shopping items have bought: bool but flow is one-directional. No model for what we have at home. No auto-populate pantry from purchased items.

## Suggested Fix
1. Add Firestore snapshots() stream in CollaborativeShoppingViewModel
2. Add PantryItem model + PantryService
3. On shopping item checked, optionally add to pantry
4. On menu generation, subtract pantry items from shopping list

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Wire Instagram import pipeline, add Paprika/JSON migration, surface import quality to user
tickets.description:
## Opportunity
Import is the #1 growth driver. Several pipeline gaps cause friction.

## Current State
### 1. Instagram pipeline missing in ImportManager
InstagramContentExtractor exists and InputDetector detects Instagram, but ImportManager._initializeStrategies() does NOT register an Instagram strategy. Falls through to UrlImportStrategy.

### 2. No app migration formats
FileImportStrategy handles CSV/Excel only. No Paprika (.paprikarecipes = zip of JSON), no Whisk, no RecipeKeeper.

### 3. Import quality invisible
ImportResultV2 has confidence, pipeline, warnings, requiresReview. SmartImportViewModel only checks isSuccess. All quality signals silently dropped.

### 4. Import onboarding minimal
OnboardingImportPage shows only URL and photo -- not text paste, YouTube, TikTok, or file import.

## Proposed Improvement
1. Create InstagramImportStrategy wiring existing extractor
2. Add PaprikaImportStrategy (unzip + parse JSON)
3. Surface confidence/warnings in post-import review banner
4. Expand onboarding to show all 6 sources with success hints

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_

tickets.title: Add micro-interaction delight: Hero animations, haptic on favorite/swipe, contextual greeting, import merge
tickets.description:
## Opportunity
The app has strong design foundations (pea animation, vegetable illustrations, shimmer skeletons, AnimatedPressable, undo-on-delete) but lacks moments of meaning -- when something important happens, the app responds identically to nothing happening.

## Current State
- No Hero animation between recipe card and detail -- the most frequent transition is a plain slide
- heroTag infrastructure plumbed through UniversalImageManager but Hero widget not used
- HapticFeedback only in AnimatedPressable -- not on favorite toggle, swipe, or cook completion
- No contextual greeting (time-of-day on home screen)
- DuplicateImportDialog only offers viewExisting/importAnyway/cancel -- no merge/diff option
- Import progress phases set synchronously -- cosmetic, not real

## Proposed Improvement
1. Add Hero(tag: recipe-image-{id}) on recipe card + detail header (1-2 hours)
2. Add HapticFeedback.heavyImpact() on favorite toggle, selectionClick on swipe
3. Add time-of-day greeting on home screen
4. Animate empty menu state with PeaLoadingAnimation
5. Add recipe merge in DuplicateImportDialog (show diff)
6. Make import progress phases reflect actual IO stages

## Effort vs Impact
Small. Disproportionately high emotional impact.

_Source: creative-ultrathink scan #23_
